title: Derived pullback preserves perfect complexes
statement: Let g:T\to X be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let E be a perfect object of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex]. The derived pullback Lg^*E [def-pc-derived-pullback] is perfect on T.

proof.text: At t choose an open neighbourhood U of g(t) carrying a strictly perfect representative P of E. Restrict to the inverse image of U. Restriction commutes with derived pullback, and flatComplexDerivedPullback computes it by termwise pullback, since P is bounded with flat terms. Pullback preserves zero terms, finite free modules and the splitting equation of each finite projective summand. Thus the pulled complex is strictly perfect and gives the neighbourhood required by IsPerfect at t.
